Observing and Verbalizing Reasoning

3:18FT09 · OfficialOctober 24, 2026
Watch on YouTubeYanik_AI channel

About this episode

This episode uses official FT09 to examine how a human solver identifies and describes their own reasoning. Yannick discusses the geometric perception, inference, analogy, and hypothesis testing that can pass unnoticed within an intuitive decision. Verbalizing those steps exposes their assumptions and structure. It is part of the development method introduced in Episode 2: extracting a reusable principle first requires a sufficiently clear account of the reasoning behind it.

  • Observing human reasoning
  • Making intuition explicit
  • Transmitting principles

Notes from the author’s published description. ARC AGI 3 SRA Ep 4
